findings.description: The new explicit `params` argument is never forwarded to `self.request`, so GET query parameters are silently discarded.
findings.rationale: Calling `session.get(url, params={"page": 2})` now binds the dictionary to the new local `params` parameter instead of leaving it in `kwargs`. Since the request call forwards only `kwargs`, the server receives no page parameter and may return the wrong results. The newly supported positional argument is discarded in the same way.
